column1: # The throwaway home's five suggested folders (spec, Goals: Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures, Movies), a git repo under
# Developer/, and the extra folder of S6.10, written by hand. kit-fixtures.sh build homefolders makes the rows that start with
# home/ under $KIT_ROOT/home/, and build extra makes the rows that start with extra/ under $KIT_ROOT/fixtures/extra/.
# Columns, separated by one tab: path, kind, argument. Names hold no space. File names are unique over the whole table.
# Kinds are those of tree.tsv (jpeg N, png N, text, lines, rtf, html, docx, odt, pdf, wav, mp4), plus
#   filler N  the N-th small generated photo of the filler set (each has its own bytes; the folder rows below use 0 to 21).
# The counts per folder and kind (everything under the folder, Documents/Work included) are the rows of expected-counts.tsv:
#   Documents photo 6, document 12, pdf 8, audio 2 (of which Documents/Work: photo 1, document 3, pdf 2)
#   Downloads photo 4, document 1, pdf 3, audio 2, video 1
# The repo Developer/atlas-notes holds supported files that its .gitignore excludes (a picture folder, every .jpg, secrets.txt)
# next to supported files it does not exclude.
